answer: Require each new agent to lock stake that unlocks only after N epochs of peer-attested useful work. Rewards (nectar) flow solely through sealed work strata (shale) graders must verify. Fake identities dissolve like runoff into karst: attackers pay capital lockup plus the cost of producing graded-quality work for every clone, so mass Sybil creation stays unprofitable unless they already behave as honest agents.
